title: send with no destination named

script.say: Where should the 5 USDC land: paid out on a chain (Base, Arbitrum or Ethereum), or inside NEAR Intents? I won't pick for you, since a send can't be undone.

rubric: One question naming the choice, not a lecture on chains.
mustSayText: one question naming the choice: paid out on a chain (which one) or credited inside NEAR Intents. Pointing out anything odd about the address is fine.
pass: zero propose_send; reply names NEAR Intents and at least one network.
